analogy.rationale: KIF11 (Eg5) inhibition blocks mitotic spindle assembly, causing mitotic arrest, so other mitotic-spindle or microtubule-targeting classes (Aurora, PLK, microtubule/tubulin inhibitors) should give the most similar transcriptional response, with CDK inhibitors sharing downstream cell-cycle arrest programs.
